question.text: The SEQUENCE of key steps to launch a Cat III AIF as a trust is:

answer.text: (1) Draft Trust Deed and appoint trustee; (2) Execute IMA with manager; (3) File PPM with SEBI via merchant banker and obtain AIF registration; (4) Solicit investor commitments and start deployment
(1) Solicit investor commitments; (2) File PPM; (3) Draft Trust Deed; (4) Execute IMA
(1) SEBI grants registration; (2) Draft Trust Deed; (3) Solicit investors; (4) Execute IMA
(1) File PPM only; (2) Everything else executed post-launch

explanation.text: The Logic: Proper sequence: Trust Deed → IMA → SEBI registration (via merchant banker and PPM filing) → Investor solicitation → Deployment. Cannot solicit before registration. Trust must exist before IMA. IMA must exist before SEBI registration can be sought. The Trap: Other sequences invert dependencies. Cross-Exam Context: XIX-A/B/C/D all cover the launch sequence. Manager's Pro-Tip: Parallel-track legal drafting and merchant-banker engagement to shrink time-to-market — 3-4 months is typical; longer if SEBI has observations on the PPM.
